scope: Independent symbolic review of the exact staged submission, not listening and not official grade prediction. Read only original source/data, new review output only.

definitions.symbolic_source: Original submitted token manifests and the exact existing 45-song 32-bar real-reference token crops; same8-subdivision quantization, note-velocity reconstruction4*v+2. Bonus real piano retokenized by identical codec, maximum16bars.
definitions.polyphony: For each piece, count note intervals active at centers of a1/8-annotation-beat grid, including duplicate pitches; durations clipped at piece endpoint. No CC64/pedal acoustic sustain. Notes that began before cropped real-reference window are absent, slightly undercounting reference onset-window boundary polyphony.
definitions.register: MIDI pitch96=C7 and36=C2, descriptive thresholds, not universal quality constraints.
definitions.rhythm: Per-bar SET of quantized onset positions; ignores pitch, velocity, duration and onset multiplicity. Identical rhythm is not identical music. Adjacent equality includes empty bars if any.
definitions.same_pitch_retrigger: Fraction of onsets whose same pitch has another active note from an earlier onset; valid merged voices may overlap, so not an error rate.
definitions.fairness: Real-reference songs are in final all896-song fit: these are descriptive distribution comparisons, not held-out performance. Real-reference tempos/meters vary; notes_per_beat normalizes annotated beat counts but cannot equate all metrical interpretations. No grading threshold assumed.
definitions.chord_baselines: Only evaluated after generation. Oracle per-prompt constant chord uses ground-truth majority and is NOT allowed inference baseline or submission. Marginal-match probability independent of actual bar alignment. Useful to interpret lowCA and temporal dependence; does not assess alternative valid harmonizations.

descriptive_mean_difference_bootstrap.method: 5000 independent whole-piece resamples per group; seed57391. Descriptive distribution uncertainty, no independent final test or perceptual score.

CA_minus_marginal_expectation.interpretation: ObservedCA is low relative to the same generated/GT marginal chord-distribution match probability; interval includeszero, so this does not establish inverse alignment. This is a diagnostic expectation, not an executable inference method or grade.

source_review.generator_evidence: generate_bonus.py opens melody.mid and beat_midi.txt only; gt piano/chords accessed by evaluation only. Basic continuation opens the provided8bar MIDI and beats.
source_review.all896_training_reference_overlap: Final basic and roles models fit all896 official training songs. Real45 is not held out for final models; report_analysis.json explicitly discloses it. Diagnostic validation ancestor checks exist in train.py.
source_review.bonus_selection_test_reuse: bonus_sampling_comparison.json selectsT1 from same10 prompts using their GT-based5metric mean. Independent_test=false disclosed. Thus selection and report are not independent, and improvement cannot be interpreted as generalization.
source_review.unconditional_fixed_clock: infer.py fixes32generatedbars to4beats/bar and120BPM; meter/tempo are controllers rather than modeled output. Constraints do not prove melody/harmony/phrasing quality.
source_review.generation_constraints: Grammar masking and64notes/bar cap enforce syntax/piano range/duration bounds. Basic allows same-pitch rearticulation before previous release using extra channels; bonus forbids it to retain exactly2tracks.
